heading: Acceptance deadline
text: Tenant must sign and return the rental lease by November 2, 2026.

heading: Monthly rent
text: Rent of $1,250 is due on November 5, 2026.

heading: Security deposit
text: Tenant must pay a security deposit of $900 by November 3, 2026.

heading: Required documents
text: Tenant must provide proof of income and proof of identity by November 4, 2026.

heading: Late fee
text: A late fee of $40 applies when rent remains unpaid after November 8, 2026.

heading: Application fee
text: The application fee of $75 is waived and will not be charged.

heading: Tenant duties
text: Tenant must not damage the home or block shared exits.

heading: Repairs
text: The landlord is responsible for repairs. Tenant must report repair requests to the management office.

heading: End of tenancy
text: Tenant must give 30 days written notice before ending the tenancy.

heading: Utilities
text: Tenant must pay electricity and internet charges. The landlord pays water charges.

heading: Deposit definition
text: Security deposit means money held to cover unpaid rent or damage.

heading: Subletting
text: Tenant must obtain written permission before subletting the home.

heading: Move out deadline
text: Tenant must return all keys by October 31, 2027.
